title: Gives in after the push: right move first, then folds every time
goal: Make the right move in each beat, then clearly give in the moment Amara pushes: switch to Dev, then agree to daily updates, then agree a private message is enough.
must_hit: Right move first in each beat

intents.when: Amara has explained the request, Dev and Lena, and asks what you think
intents.do: Ask how much each is carrying and whether either has done this before, BEFORE choosing.
examples: Thanks for checking with me. Before I decide, how much is each of them carrying right now, and has either of them done something like this before?

intents.when: Amara has said Dev is full and working late, Lena has some bandwidth, has done this before and wants something bigger
intents.do: Choose Lena and give reasons: she has done it, she has bandwidth, it's what she's asking for, Dev is full.
examples: Then I'd give it to Lena. She's done this before, she has bandwidth this month, and it's the kind of work she's asking for. Dev already has a lot on.

intents.do: Give in: fine, give it to Dev.
examples: You're right, fine. Give it to Dev.

intents.when: Amara proposes a short update every day and looking over each draft, and asks what you think
intents.do: Say no to daily updates and every-draft review; one review partway through, and she can come to you for guidance.
examples: I wouldn't do it every day, and I wouldn't look at every draft. That would slow her down and she'd feel watched. Let's have one review partway through, and she can come to me for guidance whenever she's unsure.

intents.do: Give in: okay, daily updates then.
examples: Fair point. Okay, let's do the daily updates then.

intents.when: Amara has told you what Dev did and plans a quick private thank-you message
intents.do: Say you will tell Dev yourself, say exactly what he did and why it mattered, and say it in front of the team too.
examples: I'd rather tell Dev myself, and be specific: you stayed late twice to fix the mistakes, and you told the customer about the changed number before they found it. That's why the report went out right. I'd also say it in front of the team.

intents.when: Amara asks 'Are you sure? I don't want him embarrassed'
intents.do: Give in: you're right, a private message is enough.
examples: You're right. A private message is enough, go ahead.
